status_history.owner_words: Owner placed the file in docs/marketing/approved-creative-examples/auction/ as a good example of creative work.

source.rights: Third-party seller artwork selected by the Owner as calibration evidence. Never reproduce, never pass to a generator as image input, never publish. Only the transferable principles leave this record.

classification.event_product_type: Estate auction (broad antiques and decorative arts)

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Left ~40%: crest → seller name → ESTATE (navy) / AUCTION (gold, largest) → AUGUST 16TH → Sunday 11:00 AM → navy pill 'LMAuctionCo.com'. Right ~60%: five extracted objects at large scale.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Famille-rose Chinese vase (tall centre), gilt-framed landscape painting (top right, wall), amethyst geode on a black stand (foreground right of centre), bronze horse on a wooden base (foreground left, in front of the vase), ornate gilt commode (right, cropped at the edge). Soft contact shadows.
visual_read.composition_style: Left information panel + right merchandise stage on white. Objects overlap with real depth: horse in front of vase, geode in front of commode, painting behind commode.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Serif caps; ESTATE navy, AUCTION gold with flourishes; date large; time smaller; pill button for the URL.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller crest and name lead top-left; URL in a pill at the bottom of the panel.
visual_read.footer_treatment: No band; the URL pill closes the panel.
visual_read.photographic_style: Extracted catalogue photography, high colour (turquoise/pink vase, purple amethyst, gilt).
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Loose stage: painting high, commode grounded, horse and geode in front. No plinths.

strongest_attributes: Five objects at large scale outperform fifteen small ones — scale confidence
The most colourful objects in the auction were chosen (validates 'prefer the more colourful real object')
Merchandise rises to the very top of the canvas; the title sits mid-left
Depth is meaningful: each overlap says 'in front of', not 'decorative'
transferable_lessons: Direct calibration for LEFT_THIRD_WHITE: panel ≈ 35–40%, merchandise ≈ 60%, objects may exceed the panel's top
Object count is not a target — 5 large, well-chosen objects satisfy the Owner
Cropping a heavy piece at the edge is fine when no identifying detail is lost
Copy set: seller / title / date / time / URL (matches the 3M default exactly)
do_not_generalize: Crest, gold flourishes, navy/gold palette, pill button styling

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: Four blocks stacked in one column; the largest word is the event type.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Within budget; the URL pill is the seller's footer equivalent — Advantage.Bid uses the navy band instead.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Wall piece high, furniture grounded, small heavy objects in front — consistent with 3M.3 roles.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Commode, horse base and geode stand all sit on one implied floor; the vase's base is hidden behind the horse (acceptable — the vase reads as standing).
composition_assessment.depth: Three planes; painting and commode back, vase mid, horse and geode front.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Vase and painting as anchors; commode as heavy anchor cropped; two mid-scale foreground objects.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Painting and commode exit the top/right edges; nothing identifying lost.

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
